_about: Pinnacle bosses: endgame fights for level 60 heroes. Entering costs one Pinnacle Sigil — a very rare drop from enemies of level sigilDrops.minLevel or higher (normal / elite / boss chance per kill; never from rifts). Every boss is its own file in this folder: waves (enemy ids, content/enemies), scale (health and damage multipliers), uniques (pinnacle-only uniques, "pinnacle": "<boss id>" in legendaries/uniques), uniqueChance (chance for one of them per kill), title and frame (cosmetics granted on the first kill). weekly: bonus for the first kill of each boss in a week (Monday 00:00 UTC).
